{{Quote|You're looking for CorSec officer Nola Indervin. This report has some delicate things to say about CorSec, so make sure you don't give it to any other officer except Nola.|Jadam Questrel to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Nola Indervin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Corellian Security Force]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CorSecTrooperMaleTemplate.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Randomly generated male depiction of Nola Indervin, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Nola Indervin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
